reason: Memory exhaustion when validating oversized collections. Zod 3 comes in only through @expo/cli and eslint-plugin-react-hooks, which validate developer-written config at build and lint time. It isn't in the app bundle and never sees user input. Clears when Expo moves to zod >= 4.6.6.

RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification accepts malformed signatures. Used only by @expo/cli for dev-server HTTPS and Expo Updates code signing. The app doesn't use Expo Updates, and node-forge isn't in the app bundle. Clears when @expo/cli takes node-forge > 1.4.0.

Missing bounds check in uuid v3/v5/v6 when a caller passes its own buffer. Comes in through xcode <- @expo/config-plugins, which edits the iOS project during prebuild. Not in the app bundle. Clears when @expo/config-plugins drops uuid < 11.1.1.

Prototype poisoning in objects returned by deepmerge's mergeObject(). Comes in through @expo/config, which merges app.json at build time, and jest-config (dev only). The app never imports it, and it isn't in the app bundle. Clears when @expo/config drops or patches deepmerge.
